basic_info.description: Discover this bright and spacious home at 3333 Lincoln Way, a 2 bed, 2 bath, 1,790 sq. ft. residence perfectly positioned in Central Sunset, just across from Golden Gate Park. The charming facade and front garden lead you into a sunlit, open floor plan with hardwood floors throughout. The living and dining areas offer ample space for entertaining, while the beautifully renovated kitchen features large quartz countertops, stainless steel appliances, and abundant cabinetry.    The primary bedroom includes a en suite bathroom, while the adjacent sunroom offers flexibility as a home office or third bedroom. The garage level presents potential for expansion (subject to city regulations), adding exciting possibilities for customization. The backyard is a blank canvas, ready to become a private oasis for outdoor gatherings and relaxation.    With Golden Gate Park as your front yard, Ocean Beach, the Great Highway, and the shops and eateries of Irving and Judah Streets just minutes away, this home balances city convenience with coastal tranquility.
